theme: 心跳頻率 / 視窗回家基本底座
wake_rules: ACTIVE endpoint + healthy pulse => no model wake
IDLE with pending authorized work => WAKE_REQUEST at escalation boundary
two consecutive endpoint misses => STALE + recovery request
material owner/peer/control event => immediate escalation allowed
rate-limit => durable checkpoint + deferred wake, never task/window multiplication
metabolism_rules: every 10min check pressure only; no delta => NO_OP
every 30min or pressure threshold => compact WASTE/QUARANTINE metadata
routine pulse creates no durable per-pulse log
reflection_rule: Before a controllable runtime/window exits with unfinished authorized work, emit exactly one durable final reflection pulse and handoff/wake candidate before release. Duplicate reflection_id is NO_OP.
formal_adoption: After current Step-008 atomic checkpoint, Windchime A may route exactly one bounded A->B packet; B builds; C independently verifies before stable bootstrap status.
real_runtime_truth: 1-minute or 5-minute real liveness is not LIVE until owner Windows Local Command Tower/Small-Nest or another explicitly authorized always-on runner returns reality evidence.
